requirement.original: Fix fetch-images-batch.py to read gaode API key from environment variable instead of hardcoded expired key. The script has a hardcoded gaode API key `c0a3b4e300f38b4038845a8a24a0e348` which is expired. The working key is in env var $AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY. Find all hardcoded key references and replace with os.environ.get("AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY").
requirement.clarified: The hardcoded key `c0a3b4e300f38b4038845a8a24a0e348` no longer exists in the file. The actual bug is that the script reads os.environ.get("GAODE_API_KEY") at line 130, but the correct env var name used throughout the project is AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY. Replace GAODE_API_KEY with AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY at lines 127 and 130.
requirement.what: Rename env var reference from GAODE_API_KEY to AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY in scripts/fetch-images-batch.py
requirement.why: GAODE_API_KEY is never set in the runtime environment; AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY holds the working key. The wrong name causes the geocoding fallback to always be skipped silently.

included: Replace os.environ.get("GAODE_API_KEY") with os.environ.get("AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY") at line 130
Update comment on line 127 to reference AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY
excluded: Changes to .claude/skills/gaode-maps/ scripts (already use AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY correctly)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Gaode geocoding fallback in fetch-images-batch.py never executes; gaode_key is always None
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Script reads os.environ.get("GAODE_API_KEY") but the working Gaode API key is stored in AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY. GAODE_API_KEY is never populated in the environment, so gaode_key evaluates to None and the geocoding branch is unconditionally skipped.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - env var name mismatch, no single introducing commit identified; the gaode-maps skill settled on AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY while fetch-images-batch.py used the older GAODE_API_KEY name
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The script was likely written before the AMAP_MAPS_API_KEY convention was established by the gaode-maps skill integration
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: City coordinates cannot be resolved via Gaode geocoding fallback, degrading image fetch quality for Chinese cities
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present in current HEAD (d6c8d0b); exact introduction commit not identified
